title: Message from your guide
message: Namaste! This is Suresh, your guide for Everest Base Camp. We reach Dingboche today — remember to hydrate and walk slow. Weather looks clear for Kala Patthar.

title: Guide assigned
message: Anita Gurung has been assigned as your guide for the Classic Everest Base Camp Trek departing 5 October.

title: Balance due in 14 days
message: Complete the $7,200 payment for your 20 October Everest Base Camp departure to keep your 4 slots reserved.

title: Payment received
message: We received your $3,600 payment for the 5 October Everest Base Camp Trek. Your booking is confirmed.

title: Trek starts tomorrow
message: Your Everest Base Camp Trek departs tomorrow. Check-in is at 8:00 AM at the Everest Treks Co. office in Thamel.

title: How was your trek?
message: You completed the Classic Everest Base Camp Trek with Everest Treks Co. on 14 August. Share a review to help other trekkers.
